title: MoleculeNet: a benchmark for molecular machine learning
contribution: Standardized molecular datasets, features and evaluation choices.
limitation: A custom HIV replay is a derivative, not the official leaderboard split.
project_implication: Keep dataset/split hashes and distinguish campaign utility from prediction quality.

title: Therapeutics Data Commons: Machine Learning Datasets and Tasks for Drug Discovery and Development
contribution: Therapeutics task definitions, data access and evaluation resources.
limitation: Task collections have distinct endpoints and data terms.
project_implication: Use a task registry; retain assay semantics instead of merging heterogeneous labels.

title: LIT-PCBA: An Unbiased Data Set for Machine Learning and Virtual Screening
contribution: Curated experimental assay labels, artifact filtering and AVE splitting.
limitation: Ascertainment by baseline enrichment; release-specific residual overlap and metric-definition risks.
project_implication: Audit release/phenotype/overlap and distinguish fixed-FPR enrichment.

title: Accelerating high-throughput virtual screening through molecular pool-based active learning
contribution: Pool-based model-guided screening of docking libraries.
limitation: Docking-score retrieval is not wet-lab assay confirmation.
project_implication: Use a strong Greedy baseline and label computational versus assay endpoints.

title: Traversing Chemical Space with Active Deep Learning: A Computational Framework for Low-data Drug Discovery
contribution: Three-task low-data acquisition study with known-active starts, similarity and frozen-model controls.
limitation: Reviewed ChemRxiv v3, not journal text; task scope, VDR caption and MI-direction questions.
project_implication: Add no-retrain/similarity controls and initialization sensitivity; resolve exact-code semantics.

title: Sample efficient reinforcement learning with active learning for molecular design
contribution: Active learning coupled to RL molecular generation for oracle efficiency.
limitation: Generation and expensive scoring differ from fixed-pool binary replay.
project_implication: Treat as related methodology, not a directly comparable result table.

title: Reinforced Active Learning for Large-Scale Virtual Screening with Learnable Policy Model
contribution: Learned RL policy for virtual-screening acquisition, with batch/runtime analyses.
limitation: Its task, model and budget protocol differ from the proposed study.
project_implication: Use as closest RL prior art and define a narrow operational comparison.

title: ALF: An Active Learning Framework for Scientific Discovery
contribution: Modular offline/online acquisition framework; inspected Appendix F notes synchronous assumptions.
limitation: A 2026 preprint and version-specific implementation, not a survey of all tools.
project_implication: Test an adapter and compare operational capabilities without broad novelty claims.

title: PAL: Parallel active learning for machine-learned potentials
contribution: Parallel active-learning modules coordinated through MPI.
limitation: Applications emphasize scientific model-building, including potentials.
project_implication: Acknowledge existing asynchronous orchestration and evaluate the smaller local workflow separately.

title: Asynchronous Batch Bayesian Optimisation with Improved Local Penalisation
contribution: Asynchronous BO using local penalization around busy evaluations.
limitation: Continuous optimization does not transfer to a binary pool without adaptation.
project_implication: Implement a faithful method or identify the finite-pool approximation explicitly.

title: Batch Bayesian Optimization via Local Penalization
contribution: Batch acquisition via local penalization and a Lipschitz-based heuristic.
limitation: Assumptions and parameter choices matter for an adaptation.
project_implication: Separate within-batch redundancy control from learned strategy selection.

title: Online Learning under Delayed Feedback
contribution: Theory and algorithms for online learning with delayed feedback.
limitation: Formal regret assumptions need not match a finite assay campaign.
project_implication: Motivate delay handling without borrowing an unproved regret guarantee.

title: Parallelizing Exploration-Exploitation Tradeoffs in Gaussian Process Bandit Optimization
contribution: GP-based batch/delayed-feedback selection with theoretical and empirical evaluation.
limitation: Gaussian-process assumptions differ from an uncalibrated classifier.
project_implication: Provide a meaningful parallel acquisition control and distinguish theory from replay evidence.

title: Multi-Fidelity Cost-Aware Bayesian Optimization
contribution: Cost-aware optimization across fidelities and source biases.
limitation: Engineering examples are not proof of pharmaceutical assay fidelity.
project_implication: Keep multi-fidelity work optional until linked experimental measurements exist.

title: Bayesian Optimization over Multiple Experimental Fidelities Accelerates Automated Discovery of Drug Molecules
contribution: Multi-fidelity drug-discovery optimization with retrospective and prospective evidence.
limitation: Its docking, inhibition and dose-response outcomes are distinct measurements.
project_implication: Do not synthesize fidelity labels and call the result experimental validation.

title: BoTorch: A Framework for Efficient Monte-Carlo Bayesian Optimization
contribution: Monte-Carlo acquisition and optimization infrastructure.
limitation: A software framework alone does not establish assay utility.
project_implication: Prefer backend reuse where it preserves the information and scheduling contract.

title: Analyzing Learned Molecular Representations for Property Prediction
contribution: Assessment of learned molecular representations for property prediction.
limitation: Prediction benchmarks do not automatically establish acquisition performance.
project_implication: Use matched representation/predictor ablations and retain fingerprint controls.

title: A systematic study of key elements underlying molecular property prediction
contribution: Systematic examination of dataset/model/metric/generalization choices.
limitation: Its evaluation settings must be matched to the intended chemical extrapolation.
project_implication: Audit label distributions and scaffold overlap; report both predictive and campaign endpoints.

title: Data Leakage and Redundancy in the LIT-PCBA Benchmark
contribution: Preprint audit reporting leakage and redundancy in LIT-PCBA uses.
limitation: Findings depend on distributions, splits and similarity definitions.
project_implication: Reproduce a local identity/analog audit and preserve release-specific conclusions.

title: Deep Reinforcement Learning at the Edge of the Statistical Precipice
contribution: Interval estimates and aggregate evaluation methods for few-run RL.
limitation: The demonstrated benchmarks are not molecular assay tasks.
project_implication: Respect task hierarchy and report uncertainty instead of only mean performance.

title: Deep Reinforcement Learning that Matters
contribution: Reproducibility and experimental-reporting concerns in deep RL.
limitation: Evidence concerns general RL evaluation rather than this chemical endpoint.
project_implication: Record hyperparameters, seeds and failures and compare under matched resources.

title: Deep Bayesian Active Learning with Image Data
contribution: Bayesian active learning with uncertainty-aware acquisition in image tasks.
limitation: Image-task gains do not validate molecular uncertainty.
project_implication: Label current margin sampling honestly and test uncertainty estimates on chemical data.

title: Simple and Scalable Predictive Uncertainty Estimation using Deep Ensembles
contribution: Ensemble-based predictive uncertainty on classification/regression tasks.
limitation: Ensemble disagreement need not be calibrated on a new molecular task.
project_implication: Assess calibration and acquisition utility separately before making probabilistic claims.

title: On Calibration of Modern Neural Networks
contribution: Calibration analysis and postprocessing for neural-network predictions.
limitation: The current surrogate is logistic regression, not the studied neural models.
project_implication: Avoid interpreting a predicted score as an established success probability.

title: GuacaMol: Benchmarking Models for de Novo Molecular Design
contribution: Standardized evaluation for de novo molecular generation.
limitation: Generation is a different problem from selecting from a frozen pool.
project_implication: Keep generation outside the first study and use the source to define scope.

title: BayBE: a Bayesian Back End for experimental planning in the low-to-no-data regime
contribution: Backtesting and practical BO with encodings, asynchronous support, transfer and stopping.
limitation: Selected case studies are not binary multi-hit utility or CuraLoop customer savings.
project_implication: Test integration; match the campaign objective and pin software versions.

title: Query Matters: How Selection Strategies Influence Active Learning in Drug Discovery
contribution: Query-strategy comparison in a BRD4 docking-based simulated DMTA workflow.
limitation: A focused chemical domain and proxy score limit direct biological extrapolation.
project_implication: Study when acquisition rankings change instead of declaring one universal winner.

title: Deep Active Learning with Adaptive Acquisition
contribution: Reinforcement-trained adaptive acquisition in image datasets.
limitation: Adaptive acquisition predates CuraLoop and cross-domain transfer is unproven.
project_implication: Use as foundational prior art and compare adaptation against simpler fixed choices.
